audit.why: Riftwalk cd is 5/3.5/2 — the rank-3 breakpoint is the matchup's defining spike; the chart row disagreed across layers.
audit.corrected: phases[6] moved to Kassadin with matching why and rating; spikes[3] created.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; two dos/donts bullets were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad paste; the Nether Blade auto-reset burst tell (flagged in missing interactions) was absent.
audit.why: Riftwalk 5s rank 1 / 2s rank 3; Pantheon W 13s rank 1; E 22s rank 1; Kassadin's combo opens on a Nether Blade auto reset — the wind-up is the step-back cue.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with real numbers and the reset tell; bleed bullets replaced.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions claims Kassadin's Null Sphere is a channel Pantheon W cancels — that is a derived-flag misfire: Riot's text says Null Sphere INTERRUPTS channels, it is not itself channeled.
audit.why: Trust the description over the flag per calibration guidance; did not write the claimed interaction.

edits.after: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E his Nether Blade answer, walk — the toll he paid for one last-hit.

edits.before: Good trade: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit. Bad trade: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Good trade: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E his Nether Blade answer, walk — the toll he paid for one last-hit. Bad trade: Spending the all-in into a held Riftwalk at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his comeback.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. It governs your forward steps. - E Aegis Assault spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1 and 2s at 16 — pre-16 you punish the landing, after that you can't. His Nether Blade auto-reset wind-up is the burst tell: step back on it. Your E (22s rank 1) is the whole all-in answer — never spend it on Q poke.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: Pre-6 he has no escape — W-stun the step-up, empowered-Q, walk, and repeat on your 13s W timer.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Once your E ends at his two-item spike, Riftwalk re-engages every few seconds and you have nothing left to block the second burst.

edits.before: Late Pantheon is a starting pistol: R the flank, stun the carry, block the counter — and let the team finish what the spear started.
edits.after: At 16 his Riftwalk drops to 2 seconds and he bursts through your fall-off — you are utility now: stun for your carries, not for kills.
Level 16 Riftwalk at a 2-second cooldown is checkmate — Kassadin sidesteps your W mid-dash and one-shots squishies; the game must already be decided.
